Refresh all visible or all open views

disambiguation: Formerly named Refresh Preview, it refreshes any view type, not just reading/preview mode.
extras: Formerly named Refresh Preview; keeps the old plugin id refresh-preview for compatibility. Documentation is a demo vault shipped with each release; beta versions install via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Broader refresh scope: whole views, regardless of content provider
problem: Obsidian renders a view once when it opens, so dynamic content like Dataview queries, embeds, or plugin output goes stale until the tab is closed and reopened, losing your place.

relations.evidence: Broader refresh scope: whole views, regardless of content provider
Broader refresh scope: any view; visible/all views; file-change and timer refresh

summary: Re-renders any Obsidian view in place, keeping scroll position, via a toolbar button, commands, or automatic file-change and timer triggers.
